name: Sign Customiser
author: Sign Customiser

sections.description:
Sign Customiser is the world’s most advanced sign creation platform, trusted by 700+ merchants worldwide. This plugin seamlessly integrates Sign Customiser’s powerful features with your WooCommerce store, helping you sell more custom signs while saving time on quotes and production.

Why Choose Sign Customiser?

  • 🎨 Powerful Sign Visualizations – Give customers instant, photo-realistic previews of their custom signs with real-time 2D/3D rendering and multiple viewing angles
  • 💰 Advanced Pricing Engine – Automatically calculate prices based on materials, size, and shipping with support for volumetric pricing
  • 🏭 Streamlined Manufacturing – Generate detailed production specs and SVG files automatically for your sign makers
  • 📱 Mobile-Optimized Design – Fully responsive interface works perfectly on all devices
  • 🌍 Multi-language & Currency – Support for all languages including RTL, with automatic currency conversion
  • ⚡ Boost Conversion Rates – Interactive customization increases engagement and sales

Supported Sign Types

  • LED Neon Signs – Create vibrant, eye-catching displays with flexible LED tubing
  • Acrylic Letter Signs – Premium 2D/3D letters with optional backlighting
  • Metal Letter Signs – Elegant metallic finishes for professional signage
  • Lightbox Signs – Illuminated displays with custom graphics
  • Wooden Signs – Rustic and natural wood materials for a classic look
  • Aluminum Plate Signs – Durable, weather-resistant signage perfect for outdoor use
  • Custom Designs – Unlimited possibilities for unique sign creations

Premium Features

  • Drag, scale and rotate sign designs
  • Multiple colors and fonts per sign
  • Custom graphics and icons
  • Material options including metal, acrylic, wood, and aluminum
  • Comprehensive mounting options for indoor and outdoor use
  • Weather-resistant finishes for outdoor signage
  • Automated manufacturing emails with detailed specifications
  • SVG file exports for precise production
  • Unlimited design submissions
  • Real-time material cost calculation
  • Volumetric shipping calculations

Managing your account and accessing advanced features is done through the web admin.

sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Adds support for API connections.

1.5.4

  • Adds support for ai custom design flow.

1.5.3

  • Only marks an order as sent if it has items.

1.5.2

  • Adds more order hooks to account for different order completion scenarios.

1.5.1

  • Fixes duplicate order emails coming through.

1.5.0

  • Added a debug mode to help resolve performance issues.

1.4.1

  • Fixes an issue where the customers last name did not appear in orders.

1.4.0

  • The customiser will now display an error if you do not have an API key set, ensuring you do not miss out on any products or orders.

1.3.2

  • Added support for WordPress subdirectory installations

1.3.1

  • Ensure products generated by Sign Customiser in woocommerce are hidden in product catalogue and product page is set to noindex for search engines

1.3.0

  • Added support for lightbox customisers.

1.2.1

  • Proper metadata for product images is now generated when adding a sign to your cart. This fixes some issues with product images not displaying on product pages.

1.2.0

  • Added support for uploading custom backboard background images

1.1.0

  • Added support for syncing orders from Woocommerce to Sign Customiser.

1.0

  • Initial support for syncing products from an embedded customiser to Woocommerce cart.
